findings.why: The 1F floor-area cell has two stacked values: '434*' on the Cellar line and '1076' on the First Floor line. Both candidates are printed. 1076 is the first-floor interior area; 434* is the below-grade cellar, which the footnote says is not habitable. The printed Total of 5,399 counts both, so which one to use depends on the schema.

read_problems: Unit 1F has two floor area figures printed (434* and 1076) and multiple outdoor/limited common areas (1121 BY, 19 S); used 434 as int_sf per footnote and 1121 as ext_sf (backyard); 1076 appears to be a gross/cellar figure and is not used. Other units have multiple limited common area figures (e.g., storage plus balcony/terrace) printed together (e.g., 3F: 19(S)+25(B), 3R: 19(S)+45(B), 4F: 28(S)+25(B), 4R: 433(T)+45(B)+32(S)); only the largest/terrace-type figure was used as ext_sf where applicable (4R used 433 terrace), otherwise the first figure (storage) was used since no single combined outdoor figure was printed - actual intended ext_sf for 2F/2R/3F/3R/4F unclear since only storage footage is listed, not an outdoor terrace/balcony size.

Taxes (Annual) column (5) duplicate header label is printed but values differ from Monthly column; annual tax figures not requested were omitted correctly, but worth noting two "(5)" columns exist (Monthly and Annual) in source.
